summary: Newegg Commerce filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of Ms. Christina Ching as Chief Financial Officer effective September 14, 2026, formalizing a role she held on an interim basis since May 2024 and supplementing her duties as Chief Accounting Officer since September 2022. The promotion is internal and permanent, filling a position that had been temporarily staffed for roughly 28 months. No family relationships or related-party transactions require disclosure. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics, making it a routine executive appointment rather than a transactional event. Watch for any subsequent 6-K on equity awards, severance, or reporting-segment changes.
